title: Unbounded quotient-scalar refinement of integral direct image
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, its valuation ring $A=\mathcal O_E$ and a uniformizer $\pi$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. For a scheme $T$ put $R_T=p_T^*\underline{\mathcal O_E}=\varprojlim_{m\geq1}(A/\pi^m)_T$ [sk-def-sfb-pulled-back-coefficients, det-prop-sfb-qlbar-colimit-x-integral-limit], and $S_T=(A/\pi^n)_T$, the constant finite quotient ring sheaf, for a fixed $n\geq1$. Use the ordinary unbounded derived categories $D_R(T)=D(\operatorname{Mod}_{R_T})$, $D_S(T)=D(\operatorname{Mod}_{S_T})$ of internal module objects, the derived module pullback and pushforward with their derived adjunction [sk-def-sfb-module-derived-pushpull], and the uncompleted relative derived tensor [sk-def-sfb-derived-tensor-hom]. Set $D_{n,T}K=K\otimes^L_{R_T}S_T$, the derived scalar extension of [lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings].

For any morphism $f:X\to Y$ write $L_{f,R}\dashv F_{f,R}$ and $L_{f,S}\dashv F_{f,S}$ for these adjunctions. Let $\lambda_f:L_{f,S}D_{n,Y}\xrightarrow{\sim}D_{n,X}L_{f,R}$ be the canonical scalar/pullback balancing comparison: on flat-term K-flat representatives its forward map sends $f^{-1}(x\otimes s)$ to $f^{-1}x\otimes f^{-1}s$, using the cartesian coefficient identifications [sk-prop-sfb-cartesian-coefficients]. Define
$$\rho_{f,n,K}:D_{n,Y}F_{f,R}K\longrightarrow F_{f,S}D_{n,X}K$$
to be the adjunct under $L_{f,S}\dashv F_{f,S}$ of $D_{n,X}(\varepsilon^R_{f,K})\circ\lambda_{f,F_{f,R}K}$.

The transformation $\rho_{f,n}$ is a natural isomorphism on all of $D_R(X)$. It is the quotient-scalar refinement of the specified perfect-coefficient projection morphism [lemma-weil-pbc-perfect-projection-formula]: under the internal-module/section-module equivalence [def-weil-pbc-internal-abelian-sheaf-module-equivalence] and restriction $V_T:D(S_T)\to D(R_T)$, the composite
$$V_YD_{n,Y}F_{f,R}K\xrightarrow{V_Y\rho_{f,n,K}}V_YF_{f,S}D_{n,X}K\xrightarrow{d_f}F_{f,R}V_XD_{n,X}K$$
is exactly that projection morphism, where $d_f$ is the derived pushforward/restriction composition comparison [lem-weil-pbc-ring-sheaf-change-adjunction]. The quotient $S_T$ is resolved by $[R_T\xrightarrow{\pi^n}R_T]$ in degrees $-1,0$, augmented by the actual finite projection $R_T\to S_T$. No properness, completeness, boundedness or constructibility condition on $f$ or $K$ is imposed. For $n\geq m\geq1$, these isomorphisms commute with reduction $A/\pi^n\to A/\pi^m$, using the canonical balanced identifications $(K\otimes^L_{R_T}S_{n,T})\otimes^L_{S_{n,T}}S_{m,T}\simeq K\otimes^L_{R_T}S_{m,T}$ and the corresponding scalar/direct-image mate. Here $S_{j,T}=(A/\pi^j)_T$ for each positive $j$.
